verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents its own settlement rail: sellers charge pay or kya-pay tokens and Skyfire moves funds between buyer and seller wallets, with documented charge windows and settlement timing. Nothing in the pack says this settlement happens in stablecoins, and the wallet-balance figures never name a currency. Wallet-to-wallet settlement and card rails are adjacent capabilities, not stablecoin settlement, so this payments axis applies but the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails

citations.quote: For paid services, the seller charges the token and Skyfire moves the funds between the buyer's and seller's wallets.
Settlement may take up to 51 hours depending on token expiration and charging activity.
